description: Prepare a BID/offer on a position: returns the Seaport order to sign (EIP-712), the currency approval needed, and how to submit it. The agent reads its Seaport counter, signs, and POSTs the signed order — settlement stays on Seaport.

buyer.description: 0x address that will sign and fund the offer

currencySymbol.description: one of the market's settlementCurrencies (see list_micro_markets). A symbol resolves per market, so the same symbol can name different contracts: 'AERO' is the NEW Aero token (0x3f5b…a4Ee) on saero and the legacy Aerodrome token (0x9401…8631) on veaero. Check the address in list_micro_markets.

name.description: name markets only, e.g. 'alice' or 'alice.base.eth' — tokenId is derived

offerAmount.description: human amount the seller nets, e.g. '750' — must be positive

name: prepare_offer
